objective: Neutral end-to-end proof of Scheduled Runtime relay v3 using a fixed runtime slot, a durable transport ticket, lossy-egress retry semantics, exact UTF-8 relay persistence, and no persistent Agent reinstantiation.
scope: mechanical persistence by ecosystem-supervisor only after a valid relay
constraints: Do not reinstate any persistent Agent.
Do not modify any client project.
Reasoning runtime must not write GitHub, Drive, Dropbox or acquire gateway lease.

Transport loss must not advance logical_attempt.
Persist exact authored UTF-8 payload bytes without semantic reinterpretation.
